title: Careers at Capgemini Invent
description: Careers at Capgemini Invent Facebook Linkedin Ready to get the future you want? Welcome to Capgemini Invent, the home of digital innovation, design, and transformation with the Capgemini Group. Capgemini Invent brings together over 12,500 professionals collaborating across more than 30 studios and 60 offices worldwide. This global team includes strategists, data scientists, product and experience designers, brand experts and technologists. Together, they develop new digital services, products, experiences and business models that support sustainable growth. By scaling globally and delivering end-to-end solutions, we help leading organizations get the future they want. Join us Students and graduates Dive into endless opportunities, enhance your skills, and grow with our team at Capgemini Invent. Start your journey with us and experience continuous learning, teamwork, and professional development. Experienced professionals Advance your career by leading impactful projects with world-leading organisations. At Capgemini Invent, you’ll gain industry experience expertise and lead a strong team of change makers. Executives Empower, grow, and lead with autonomy at Capgemini Invent. We pride our executives with the freedom to innovate and drive change to lead the future. Explore the right team for you Customer First by frog Intelligent Industry Enterprise Transformation Industries Customer First by frog frog is Capgemini Invent’s creative consultancy, where bold ideas come to life through human-centred design. We help clients truly understand their customers and craft experiences that spark loyalty and drive growth. At frog, you’ll work at the intersection of design, strategy, and technology. Creating products, services and communications that make a real difference. We blend creativity with data and market insight to shape experiences that resonate and move markets. Example of roles available at frog… → Customer Experience Consultant → Service Designer → Marketing Strategist Explore roles at frog.co Intelligent Industry Intelligent Industry is where digital meets physical. Helping clients build smarter, more connected products and operations. We focus on engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing, using data and technology to drive efficiency and sustainability. In this team, you’ll help organizations innovate at scale, whether it’s designing intelligent systems, improving operations, or unlocking new revenue streams. Example of roles available in Intelligent Industry… → Digital Transformation Consultant → Supply Chain Transformation → Asset Management Enterprise Transformation Enterprise Transformation is all about helping organizations stay ahead in a world that’s constantly changing. We bring together strategy, people, processes, and technology to build more agile, resilient, and sustainable businesses. As part of this team, you’ll work with clients to rethink how they operate, from streamlining processes to embedding new ways of working. It’s about driving change from within and unlocking long-term growth. Example of roles available in Enterprise Transformation… → Change Management & Op Model → Digital Trust & Security Consultant → Data Driven Risk & Compliance Industries At Capgemini Invent , you can choose to join a capability team (Customer First by frog, Intelligent Industry, or Enterprise Transformation), or be specialised in one of our industries below. Industries available: → Aerospace & Defence, Automotive, Banking & Capital Market, Retail → Consumer Products, Energy & Utilities, Insurance, Life sciences → Life sciences, Manufacturing, Hospitality & Travel, High-tech → Public Sector, Telecomms, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment Discover how we work at Capgemini Invent Life at Capgemini Invent is shaped by Capgemini’s Values and our unique culture where we put people at the centre of everything we do, and ensure that everyone has the opportunities to shape their own unique path. Explore our culture Join our team We are a diverse collective of disruptors, change makers, movers and shakers working together to make an impact. Explore jobs at Capgemini Invent FAQs How does Capgemini Invent fit into Capgemini? Capgemini is a global consulting and technology services company that helps organizations improve how they operate by using digital tools and solutions. Within the Capgemini Group, there are several specialist brands that focus on different areas of expertise. One of these brands is Capgemini Invent, which leads on innovation and transformation. Capgemini Invent is a a global team of over 12,500 experts across more than 60 offices and 30 studios. We bring s together a unique blend of capabilities to help CxOs envision and shape the future of their businesses. We work closely with other expert brands within the Capgemini Group like frog , Synapse , Cambridge Consultants and Purpose to deliver end-to-end transformation. Find out more about what we do at Capgemini Invent . What type of roles are there at Capgemini Invent? At Capgemini Invent, you can find professions in Strategy & Transformation and Creative & Design . We offer positions for early career professionals, experienced experts and executives, and these roles vary depending on the team you are in. Examples of roles include: Change Management Consultant User Researcher Data Analyst Find out more about what these roles do on our profession or experienced level pages. What is the recruitment process like at Capgemini Invent? The recruitment process at Capgemini Invent involves several steps which includes general video and phone interviews, group assessments and can include behavioural, technical assessments. It is entirely dependent on the country you are applying for and the role you are also going for. Here is a brief overview: Application : Submit your resume and any other required documents, such as cover letter. Interviews : You may have phone, video, or in-person interviews. These can include behavioural, technical, and cultural fit assessments. You may also get asked to join an assessment centre with other potential candidates to do group exercises. Decision : After the interviews, the recruitment team will inform you of their decision and provide feedback. What benefits and career development opportunities does Capgemini Invent offer? At Capgemini invent, we support growth through a framework built on three pillars: Everyday Empowerment, Shared Energy, and Impactful Experiences. Everyday Empowerment : Make the most of hybrid working and our Flex Abroad scheme which allows you to work abroad for up to 45 days per year. Grow your career through award winning development programs like Consulting Skills Workshop (CSW) and Invent Director Excellence (IDE) , designed to support your career at every stage. Shared Energy : Be part of an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity. Join global events like InventX and connect through employee networks such as OUTfront, CulturALL, and NeuroAbility that champion inclusion, belonging, and community across Capgemini. Impactful Experiences : Work with leading organizations to drive sustainability change. Through initiatives like Impact Together Week, you can contribute your skills to meaningful causes. Explore more about our culture and benefits at Why Join Capgemini Invent . Project stories Scroll below to discover a few example of real-life projects that our consultants at Capgemini Invent have been working on ↓ Turning climate goals into action “One project that I was proud of was supporting a leading Belgium telecom company integrate sustainability into their strategic planning, forecasting the impact of decisions on carbon emissions and optimizing long-term plans to align investments and operations with environmental targets” – Raphaël Vercoustre, Consultant, Belgium Unlocking insights from real-time data “In my latest project I enabled my client, a global commercial vehicle manufacturer, to gain actionable insights into their processes based on the analysis of real-time process data from the as-is event logs in their system. The ability to monitor and report accurate process KPIs was the cherry on top!” – Pia Steffes, Manager, Intelligent Industry, Germany Transforming customer experience at scale “I worked with large international banks to define their roles and structures of the future, enabling them to be closer to their customers. Focusing on co-creation and embracing change, we achieved remarkable outcomes, such as bringing new, customer-centric ways of working to thousands of employees.” – Christopher Schlode, Senior Manager, frog, UK Innovating infrastructure for a greener grid “A huge number of wind turbines are needed to achieve the climate targets. The increasing transport of wind turbine components on the road infrastructure is full of challenges. One solution is to increase the transport of wind turbine components by waterway. In one of my favourite projects, we are facilitating the transport by waterway with a user-friendly database.” – Malte Jünger, Manager, Public Sector, Germany Discover Capgemini Invent What we do Staying at the forefront of innovation, spearheading real sustainable progress, and impacting the lives of millions takes the collaborative effort of all kinds of innovators. Explore what we do Connect with us on social media Linkedin Youtube Instagram Glassdoor

title: Senior Talent Liaison - Employee Relations & Reintegration
description: Our client is a leading organization seeking a senior expert to manage complex employee relations and reintegration processes. This role focuses on driving end-to-end sickness, off-boarding, and legal compliance strategies while balancing operational excellence with a human-centric approach. The successful candidate will act as a strategic partner to business leaders and external stakeholders to ensure fair and legally sound outcomes. Own and continuously improve the end-to-end sickness, reintegration, and employee relations processes from a strategic and legal perspective. Lead complex reintegration pathways for employees on long-term incapacity to ensure sustainable returns to work. Manage the full off-boarding lifecycle for various scenarios, including dismissals and reorganizations, up to senior management levels. Prepare and negotiate complex exit package calculations and related legal documentation in collaboration with union representatives. Handle sensitive employee relations matters such as conflict resolution, grievances, and disciplinary actions with discretion. Monitor changes in labor legislation to translate regulatory updates into actionable policies and digital HR workflows. Leverage data analytics and reporting tools to support strategic decision-making and proactive process management. You have a Master's degree in HR, Law, or a related field. You bring 8+ years of experience in Human Resources with specific expertise in Belgian labor law , sickness management , and reintegration . You possess advanced skills in off-boarding processes , including exit package calculations and negotiating settlements with unions. You possess strong data literacy and experience with Power BI to inform strategic decision-making. You're proactive and solution-oriented with high integrity and a human-centric approach to sensitive situations. You are fluent in French , Dutch , and English . Nice to Haves Experience with digital transformation , automation , or agile/product ownership in an HR environment. Certification in occupational health , labor law , or project management .
